channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: From Sunlight to 50,000 Plates: How Mount Abu’s Solar Kitchen Is Redefining Sustainable Mass Cooking
item.description: India’s largest solar-powered kitchen in Rajasthan shows how clean energy can feed thousands while cutting fuel use and emissions.

item.title: TCWI Report 2025: Bengaluru Retains No. 1 Spot as India’s Best City for Women; Gurugram Rises on Inclusive Work Culture
item.description: India’s 2025 city rankings show how inclusive workplaces, safety measures and social infrastructure are shaping women’s urban experiences.

item.title: MP Raghav Chadha Spends Day as Blinkit Delivery Rider, Highlights Gig Workers’ Struggles
item.description: Raghav Chadha turns Blinkit delivery rider for a day purportedly to highlight the systemic exploitation within the gig economy.

item.title: Kashmiri Man Detained at Ram Mandir after Attempting Namaz; Family Cites Mental Illness, Police Continue Probe
item.description: A mentally ill man from Jammu and Kashmir was detained at Ayodhya’s Ram Mandir, raising questions about security, empathy and mental health.

item.title: Elderly NRI Couple Loses Over ₹14.85 Cr in Cyber Fraud After Returning From US
item.description: A senior IIT alumnus and his doctor wife, who returned from the US to serve India through an NGO, are reconsidering their move after suffering major losses in a cyber fraud.

item.title: From Phalodi to the Power Grid: How One Woman’s Solar Plant Is Redefining Rural Empowerment in Rajasthan
item.description: A Rajasthan woman’s journey from village life to running her own solar plant shows how clean energy is quietly empowering rural India.

item.title: MP High Court Warns Parents Can Be Prosecuted as Chinese Manjha Use Continues Ahead of Makar Sankranti Festival
item.description: The Madhya Pradesh High Court has ordered strict enforcement of the Chinese manjha ban, making parents liable if minors use the deadly kite string.

item.title: Death of 28-Year-Old Hindu Driver in Bangladesh Triggers Investigation, Raises Minority Safety Concerns
item.description: The death of a young auto-rickshaw driver has prompted a police investigation and revived concerns about safety, accountability, and trust among Bangladesh’s minority communities.

item.title: From the Frontlines to the UN Stage: How Major Swathi Turned Women Into Peacemakers in South Sudan
item.description: An Indian Army officer’s women-led initiative in South Sudan transformed fear into dialogue and earned global recognition from the United Nations.

item.title: Madhya Pradesh: Motorcyclist Dies in Indore After Throat Allegedly Slit by Banned Chinese Manjha
item.description: A motorcyclist’s death in Indore after contact with banned Chinese manjha highlights weak enforcement and recurring public safety risks during kite-flying seasons.
